description: Show what changed in a Spanish legal text, with article-level source evidence and clearly separated practical implications.

defaultPrompt: Compare two versions of a Spanish legal provision and cite the exact changes.
Find relevant notices in a BOE issue and separate publication from effective dates.
interface.longDescription:
Show what changed in a Spanish legal text, with article-level source evidence and clearly separated practical implications.

Includes a focused assistant workflow, official-source references, review examples and a Python 3.11+ read-only adapter. In ChatGPT, uses available native browsing/file tools; in Claude Code or Codex, the bundled scripts can retrieve official data directly when networking is permitted. No separate account, API key or publisher-hosted server is required for this skills release.

No comprehensive legal advice, compliance certification, private case-law database, automatic applicability determination or persistent monitoring. Consolidated text is not a substitute for checking the official publication.

Independent software by Sami Halawa. Not affiliated with Spanish public authorities.
